_comment: The ndX ranking panel ('Find informative projections'), drawn by emtk's view_form over ndxplorer.analysis.projection_rank_model.ProjectionRankModel. The table is a data_table section; its columns come from the model because the score's name and range depend on the method.

sections.label: Rank by
sections.description: What makes a view informative. Separation (default): how many bursts fall into clearly separated islands -- donor-only, acceptor-only and FRET species in E vs S, a dynamic population off the static FRET line; one population scores 0 however correlated. Correlation: parameters that move together (related measurements, not populations). Classes (only with gates or clusters): views that keep the labelled bursts apart.

sections.label: Classes
sections.description: The labels a view should keep apart: the gate in the Selection table, each gate as its own population, the clusters, or a z parameter that holds labels. Parameters a gate is defined on are left out.

sections.label: Bursts
sections.description: How bursts count in the Separation score. Low-photon bursts are wide (shot noise) and fill the valleys between FRET populations: weight each burst by its photons, or keep only bursts with at least Min photons. Needs a 'Number of Photons' column.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: Bursts with fewer photons than this are left out of the Separation score.

sections.label: Sample
sections.description: Bursts drawn at random for scoring. The same sample serves every view, so views are compared on identical bursts.

buttons.label: Start
buttons.description: Start the ranking, continue it, or restart it with new settings.

buttons.label: Pause
buttons.description: Stop scoring; Start continues from here.

sections.label: Show islands on the map
sections.description: Colour the map by the islands the Separation score found in the selected view (the view must be on the axes).

sections.title: Ranked views - click one to show it
